explanation.archive_start: The Open-Meteo Previous Runs archive of ECMWF IFS 0.25 begins with the 3 Feb 2024 00 UTC run: the first value at nominal lead 1 is valid at 2024-02-04 00:00 UTC (temperature) and 2024-02-03 22:00 UTC (precipitation; the first 3-hourly total is spread over 22, 23 and 00 UTC). Lead N starts N - 1 days later. Consistent with the M4.2 coverage matrix (first complete lead-1 IST day 5 Feb 2024).
explanation.boundary_days: An IST day spans 18:30 UTC to 18:30 UTC, so the day containing the start instant is partly covered: 19/24 hours for Tmax/Tmin (00-18 UTC), 21/24 for rain per IST day (22-18 UTC), 6/24 for rain per 08:30 IST day (22-03 UTC). These days are correctly withheld (value null).
explanation.evidence: Pattern identical at all 36 points and 7 leads; no complete ECMWF day precedes a missing one; no complete row has fewer than 24 hours; the request covered 2024-01-31..2024-03-01 UTC. Start instants are inferred from hour counts (hourly source values are not stored); two independent rain windows agree (22:00 UTC).
explanation.not: not a request/download failure (D), not a request-construction issue, not a spatial effect
